rapport_notes: Professional and patient through many interruptions (customer stepping away twice, correcting suite numbers), thorough with a complex commercial client.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No true emotional concern was raised -- his questions (building access, picture hanging, credit card timing) were all factual/process questions answered directly.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: if the move goes faster than what we have anticipated, then of course you pay less... if the move goes a little bit more than what we have expected, then of course you pay more

top_strength: Extremely thorough and patient handling of a complex multi-stop commercial move with numerous interruptions, referencing a comparable prior move to build a credible, well-grounded personalized estimate.
coaching_note: The Communication differentiator (day-before call, named crew lead, inbox updates) was never proactively delivered -- only a reactive "we'll call when we arrive" answer to his building-access question, which isn't the same commitment.
